enemy-042-combat-synthetic.method: Use the uninterrupted lateral interval through the armored cranial shell on three comparable head-readable poses per clip. Endpoints are local nominal-cell coordinates and the right endpoint is exclusive, so lengthPx equals occupied-pixel width. The proxy is rigid with respect to the synthetic identity and excludes muzzle reach, stock angle, stance, detached magazine, fluid, total pose bounds and corpse width. Median idle length is the source baseline; each proposed sourceScaleByClip factor is idleMedian divided by clipMedian. These are review corrections only, not applied normalization values.
